_comment: Maps each project on the site to the Claude Code transcript directories that
produced it. Claude Code stores one .jsonl per session under
~/.claude/projects/<slugified-cwd>/, so the slug is the working directory with
'/' replaced by '-'. A project built from more than one directory (renamed repo,
work done from a parent dir) lists several. Add a project here and re-run
tools/build_ledger.py to include it in the ledger.
'since' is optional (ISO date) and drops sessions before it — useful when a
directory was reused for something unrelated beforehand.
